## Routes

Selected by ranking every descriptor endpoint by its real call-site count across the consumer
apps, then keeping the most-called **GET** routes that resolve to a real URL — not a
hand-picked list. `calls` is that count. The auth header is chosen per route from the roles
that route grants, intersected with what the calling user holds; one fixed header pair 403s
on every route granted to some other role.

A `404` under **strapi** is not a failure — it marks a route that only core serves, which is
the case for every core-native module (helpdesk). Those rows are the shape P2 is heading for.
